"''Don't worry. We need all the analysists we can get.|The student and Undersecretary Fara, c. 9 ABY|}} A [[human]] '''youngling''' attended [[At Attin Middle School Gamma]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} they were in class during [[Undersecretary]] [[Fara]]'s visit, an [[At Attin's government]] official who discussed the [[Career Assessment Test]] scheduled for the following [[Standard day|day]]. When asked about how they wanted to contribute to the [[Great Work]], the human youngling along with several other children raised their hands. After an [[Unidentified Ithorian kid|Ithorian classmate]] of theirs said they wanted to be an [[analyst]], the human schoolchild—who had held their hand raised long before—protested, nervously arguing that the analyst was the career that they wanted to pursue. In light of increasing tension, Undersecretary Fara placated the human child by noticing that [[At Attin]] needed as many analysts as possible. The child was a stout human youngling with [[Color|dark]] skin and brown, puffy [[hair]]. As a student of An At Attin Middle School Gamma, they were dressed in a beige [[Clothing|uniform]]. In addition, they possessed passive knowledge of [[Ithorese]]. ==Behind the scenes== The youngling debuted in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' that premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}} The character was portrayed by [[Esai Daniel Cross]]. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Enfant humain non-identifié |ka=უცნობი ბიჭუნა (ატ ატინი) }} [[Category:At Attin residents]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
